papers.title: Improving Healthcare Utilization in Retired Self-Employed Workers: Evidence From an Experiment in France.
papers.abstract: This study examines the impact of a program designed to address the non-take-up of social benefits on healthcare utilization among targeted at-risk formerly self-employed workers in France. We test two main hypotheses: first, that sending a self-assessment questionnaire to the treated group can increase healthcare use; second, that personalized assistance from a social worker can enhance this effect. Utilizing a quasi-experimental framework (2014-2016) and synthetic difference-in-differences models to address selective entry into the various treatments, our results reveal that proactive information outreach alone increased healthcare utilization by 0.6%, while the combined approach with personalized assistance amplified this effect to 2%. In all configurations, access to services and healthcare consumption improved, while care pathways shifted, potentially toward preventive and early-stage treatments. Our findings support the use of multiple uptake strategies, such as targeting, proactive outreach, and tailored integrated benefit packages, in overcoming barriers to healthcare.
papers.summary: 本研究探討法國針對具風險的前自雇退休勞工所設計的社會福利補貼計畫，如何影響其醫療保健使用率。透過2014至2016年的準實驗框架與合成雙重差分模型，研究測試了「主動發送自我評估問卷」與「結合社工個別化協助」兩種介入方式。結果顯示，單純的主動資訊推送能使醫療使用率增加0.6%，若加上個別化協助則能將效果擴大至2%。整體而言，這些措施不僅提升了醫療服務的可及性與消費量，也促使照護路徑轉向預防性與早期治療。
papers.significance: 此研究為克服弱勢群體醫療服務障礙提供了實證支持，證明了結合主動資訊推送與個別化協助的多重策略能有效提升醫療資源利用率。其發現對公共衛生政策設計具有重要啟示，特別是在減少社會福利未領取率及推動預防性醫療方面，有助於政策制定者優化資源配置，透過精準瞄準與客製化整合福利方案來改善公共健康結果。

papers.title: Further Findings on the Intergenerational Transmission of Alcohol Consumption.
papers.abstract: Using 43,817 parent-child pairs from 23 waves of the HILDA Survey, I study the intergenerational transmission of alcohol use within a rational model of trait transmission. Transmission is predominantly same-sex: the mother-daughter elasticity is 0.10 and the father-son elasticity is 0.09; there is no father-daughter effect. Influence peaks at ages 15-17 and re-emerges at 28-37 when offspring become parents; mothers also affect sons at both junctures. Comparisons with non-birth (adoptee-style) dyads show similar mother-daughter transmission, indicating norm-based rather than biological channels. Identification concerns are addressed with placebo reshuffling and copula-based corrections; estimates are robust across specifications. Men who remain childless are more likely to mirror maternal drinking, which-together with declining fertility and earlier alcohol-control policies-helps explain cohort declines in male drinking. The interpretation is that parental norms anchor behavior at identity-forming and role-transition ages, with strong persistence thereafter. Policy should target these windows with gender-specific, couple-level interventions alongside population levers on price, availability and marketing.
papers.summary: 本研究利用HILDA調查的43,817對親子配對資料，基於特質傳遞的理性模型探討飲酒行為的代際傳遞。研究發現，飲酒行為的傳遞主要為同性别傳遞（母女彈性0.10，父子彈性0.09），且無父女傳遞效應。這種影響在子女15至17歲及28至37歲（當子女成為父母時）達到高峰，母親在這兩個階段亦會影響兒子。透過與非親生子代的對比，證實此傳遞機制基於社會規範而非生物遺傳。此外，無子女男性更容易模仿母親飲酒，此現象結合生育率下降與早期酒精管制政策，解釋了男性飲酒率的世代下降趨勢。
papers.significance: 本研究突破性地將飲酒行為的代際傳遞歸因於社會規範而非生物因素，並精準識別出15至17歲（身份認同形成期）與28至37歲（角色轉換期）這兩個行為干預的關鍵窗口期。其發現不僅為男性飲酒率下降提供了全新的解釋視角，更對公共衛生政策具有重大啟示：未來的酒精管制應超越單一的價格與供應管制，轉向在關鍵年齡層實施針對特定性別與伴侶層面的精準干預，以達到更有效的健康促進效果。

papers.title: Promoting Safe Opioid Disposal: Experimental Evidence on Behavioral Messaging With Financial Incentives.
papers.abstract: Some patients prescribed opioid pills fail to properly dispose of their unused pills, posing a risk for others. We report results from a pre-registered field experiment testing whether behaviorally informed reminder cards increase participation in a financial incentive program for returning unused opioid pills among U.S. Veterans. The cards incorporate principles from behavioral economics, including timely reminders, implementation intention prompts, and loss framing. Relative to a cash incentive alone, the reminder cards increase both the likelihood that patients return unused pills (the extensive margin) and the number of pills returned (the intensive margin). The intervention also improves cost-effectiveness, reducing both the cost per pill returned and the cost per participant who returns pills. These findings show that low-cost behavioral messaging can meaningfully enhance the effectiveness of existing financial incentive programs for safe opioid disposal.
papers.summary: 本研究透過針對美國退伍軍人的預註冊田野實驗，探討結合行為經濟學原理（如及時提醒、執行意圖提示與損失框架）的提醒卡，能否提升帶有現金激勵的未使用阿片類藥物回收計畫的參與度。結果顯示，相較於單純提供現金激勵，加入行為訊息的提醒卡不僅提高了患者歸還藥物的機率（廣延邊際），也增加了歸還的藥物數量（集約邊際），從而顯著提升了該計畫的整體成本效益。
papers.significance: 此研究證實了低成本的行為訊息設計能有效強化現有財務激勵機制在公共衛生領域的成效。這不僅為解決阿片類藥物濫用與誤用風險提供了具備實證基礎的低成本干預策略，也突顯了行為經濟學工具在優化醫療保健支出與提升政策成本效益方面的巨大潛力。

papers.title: Electronic health records in patient care: strengths, facilitators, challenges, and future directions-a scoping review.
papers.abstract: Electronic health records are crucial medical informatics elements increasingly utilized in industrialized nations to enhance health care services. Given the significance of electronic health records in improving monitoring and evaluation, along with the necessity to deliver quality, cost-effective, and patient-centered services, this study aims to examine the strengths, limitations, challenges, facilitators, and prerequisites for the implementation and utilization of electronic health records. This study was a systematic scoping review conducted in 2023. The protocol of the Joanna Briggs Institute (2015) was employed to design and execute this scoping review, while the model by Levak et al. (2010) served as a guide for its execution. Articles were searched across six major databases, including IS Web of Sciences, PubMed, Scopus, EMBASE, Cochrane, and ProQuest, using a predefined search strategy. Google Scholar was also utilized for supplementary searches. The search period spanned from 2002 to 2022. A total of 37,694 studies were identified across six primary databases. Following evaluation in three stages-title, abstract, and full-text-71 articles were deemed eligible for inclusion in this scoping review. Qualitative analysis and data classification of the selected studies identified four main themes and 31 sub-themes related to the strengths of setting up and utilizing electronic health records. Challenges associated with the launch and implementation of electronic health records were categorized into five main themes and 47 sub-themes, while facilitators and prerequisites for launching and utilizing EHRs were classified into five main themes and 30 sub-themes. It should be noted that some sub-themes were reported in only a single study; therefore, their weight should be interpreted with caution. Finally, a five-stage process was recommended to guide the successful launch and implementation of EHRs. Healthcare managers and policymakers should comprehensively consider the strengths, limitations, challenges, facilitators, and prerequisites for launching and using electronic health records. Given the relatively limited effectiveness of government incentive policies and financial support, there is a need to assess and revise these policies to enhance the implementation of EHR. Addressing user resistance requires a greater focus on organizational culture.
papers.summary: 本篇2023年的系統性範圍審查回顧了2002至2022年間的71篇文獻，探討電子健康紀錄（EHR）在實施與應用中的優勢、挑戰、促進因素及前提條件。研究歸納出EHR的四大優勢主題與31個子主題、五大挑戰主題與47個子主題，以及五大促進因素主題與30個子主題。基於分析結果，該研究提出了一套五階段的EHR導入與實施流程，並提醒部分子主題僅出現於單一研究中，解讀時需謹慎權衡。
papers.significance: 本研究為醫療管理者與政策制定者提供了全面的EHR實施參考藍圖，強調必須綜合評估各項優劣與配套條件。研究特別點出政府現行的激勵政策與財務支持實際成效有限，亟待檢討與修訂；同時強調，要克服用戶對EHR的抗拒心理，必須著重於組織文化的改善，這對各國推動醫療數位轉型與提升服務品質具備關鍵的實務指導價值。

papers.title: Determinants of digital home spirometer use and quality parameters in management of patients with chronic obstructive respiratory disease and asthma in general practice: a mixed methods study.
papers.abstract: Determinants of telemedicine applications use by general practice patients with chronic respiratory diseases are not yet fully known. The aim of this study was twofold: (a) to assess facilitators and barriers for the use of digital home spirometers in primary care, and (b) to evaluate parameters for process quality in implementing guideline-recommended care in daily practice. The study was evaluated using a mixed-methods design. Patients with bronchial asthma or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease were instructed to take daily measurements using a digital home-spirometry device. Primary care physicians regularly controlled spirometry data using a digital monitoring portal. Telephone interviews were conducted with patients and healthcare professionals. Qualitative analysis of the transcripts was based on content analysis. Quantitative data included the assessment of quality indicators in the beginning (t0) and at the end (t1) of each individual's participation in the study, the Patient Assessment of Chronic Illness Care Short-Version (t0) and reasons for use/non-use of the spirometer (t1). Logistic regression was performed to determine predictors of use according to instructions. Altogether, 127 patients participated in the study; the average age was 59 years, 61% (n = 78) of participants were female. 21 telephone interviews with patients and healthcare professionals were conducted. Facilitators included: sense of obligation, habituation, visualization of progression, self-efficacy, physician contacts, remote treatment, and positive aspects of integration into daily practice. Barriers included: understanding of the disease, dyspnea, as well as project and technical requirements. Care providers considered time-consuming procedures and clinical assessability as barriers. At t0 and t1, approximately one third of respondents (33% resp. 36%) stated that they had received disease-specific training, and 57% stated in both cases that they had gotten the annual influenza vaccination. Logistic regression revealed that duration of disease (OR 0.96; CI 95% 0.93; 0.99), a daily measurement being too strenuous (OR 0.165; CI 95% 0.04; 0.076), and the fact that measurements could not be taken while away from home (OR 0.235; CI 95% 0.07; 0.75) to be negative predictors of use according to instructions. For the patients in the study, digital applications improved self-efficacy and self-control. However, a better understanding of these applications and additional medical feedback could be helpful for the patients using such digital applications. The evaluation of process quality parameters showed potential for improving rates of disease-related education and influenza vaccination.
papers.summary: 本研究採用混合方法，探討基層醫療中慢性呼吸道疾病（氣喘與COPD）患者使用數位家庭肺量計的促進與阻礙因素，並評估實施指引建議照護的過程品質參數。研究發現，自我效能提升、數據視覺化與醫師聯繫是主要促進因素；而疾病認知不足、呼吸困難及技術限制為阻礙因素。邏輯迴歸顯示，病程較長、測量過於耗力及無法在室外測量是未能依指示使用的負向預測因子。此外，過程品質評估顯示疾病相關教育與流感疫苗接種率仍有改善空間。
papers.significance: 此研究揭示了數位遠端醫療在基層慢性病管理中的實際應用瓶頸與成效。雖然數位工具能提升患者的自我效能與自我控制，但技術限制與臨床工作負擔限制了其全面推廣。這對未來設計更直觀、具備醫療回饋機制且融入日常生活的數位健康設備具有重要參考價值，同時也提醒醫療體系需加強患者衛教以提升遠端照護的品質與順從性。

papers.title: The role of pictograms in improving patients' medication adherence: a systematic review.
papers.abstract: Poor medication adherence remains a significant public health issue. Although pictograms are established as intuitive visual aids for medication guidance, a current evidence synthesis is lacking, particularly regarding their role in the rapidly advancing digital health landscape. To systematically evaluate the potential effect of pictograms on patients' medication adherence and exploring implications for the digital health era. We searched PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, Cochrane Library, CNKI, Wanfang Data Knowledge Service Platform, VIP Network, and CBM databases for relevant studies on the effect of pictograms on patients' medication adherence, from the inception of each database to April 27, 2025. A total of 21 articles were included, comprising 19 English and 2 Chinese publications, all of which were randomized controlled trials. These studies varied in terms of study background, sample size, and drug regimens tested. All studies had methodological limitations, with pictographic interventions differing in complexity, duration, and adherence outcomes measured. Twelve studies (57.1%) reported statistically significant effects of pictographic interventions on patient adherence. Pictograms serve as an effective adjunct to enhance medication adherence, particularly among patients managing complex medication regimens or possessing limited health literacy. Future efforts should focus on developing standardized, evidence-based pictogram libraries and integrating them into multimodal medication education systems. Incorporating pictograms into digital health platforms, such as those using AI and smart devices, represents a promising direction for enhancing their reach and impact.
papers.summary: 本研究透過系統性文獻回顧，檢視了圖像符號對提升患者用藥依從性的影響。研究納入21篇隨機對照試驗，結果顯示有57.1%的研究指出圖像符號干預對患者依從性具統計上顯著的正面效果。圖像符號作為直觀的視覺輔助工具，能有效幫助處理複雜用藥方案或健康素養較低的患者。然而，現有研究在方法學與干預複雜度上仍具差異與侷限性。
papers.significance: 此研究強調了圖像符號在解決公共衛生難題（用藥依從性差）上的實用價值，並為未來醫療發展指明方向。其最大意義在於呼籲建立標準化且基於實證的圖像符號資料庫，並提出將這些視覺輔助工具整合至人工智能與智慧裝置等數位健康平台中，這將大幅擴大其應用範圍與實際影響力。

papers.title: Predictors of low trust in national healthcare systems in 30 countries.
papers.abstract: Trust in national healthcare systems is associated with health behaviour and patient outcomes. Individuals with high trust are more likely to participate in preventive services and adhere to medical advice, whereas low trust is linked to poorer health, reduced service use, and lower patient satisfaction. Despite extensive research on interpersonal trust in healthcare professionals, cross-national evidence on public trust in healthcare systems remains limited. This study examines levels of trust in 30 healthcare systems and identifies sociodemographic, attitudinal and experiential predictors associated with low trust. The analysis draws on nationally representative data from the 2021 International Social Survey Programme, including 40,392 respondents aged 18 and older across 30 countries. Trust was dichotomised as high versus low trust. Multilevel logistic regression models with random intercepts at the country level were applied to account for data clustering. Individual level predictors included sociodemographic characteristics, health status, political orientation, attitudes toward vaccination and alternative medicine, perceptions of doctors, perceived inequalities in access, personal experiences with access barriers, and satisfaction with the last medical visit. At country level, the Corruption Perceptions Index was used. Trust showed wide variation across countries, peaking in Scandinavian nations and remaining comparatively low in countries such as Poland, Suriname, and Russia. Logistic regression indicates that a high level of trust is associated with low levels of corruption at country level. Younger respondents and women were more likely to report low trust. Poor self-rated health emerged as one of the strongest predictors of low trust. Negative attitudes toward vaccination and voting for extreme political parties were also associated with low trust. Furthermore, both personal experiences of access barriers and perceptions of unequal access were associated with a higher likelihood of low trust. Respondents dissatisfied with their last medical treatment and those with generally negative views of doctors showed markedly lower trust in the healthcare system. Trust in national healthcare systems is associated with a broad set of individual and contextual factors. These findings highlight multiple potential leverage points for strengthening trust, ranging from improving doctor-patient interactions to addressing structural inequalities in healthcare access.
papers.summary: 本研究利用2021年國際社會調查計畫中30個國家、逾4萬名受訪者的數據，透過多層次邏輯迴歸分析影響民眾對國家醫療體系信任度的預測因子。結果顯示，北歐國家信任度最高，而波蘭、蘇里南及俄羅斯較低。在國家層面，貪腐程度較低與高信任度顯著相關；在個人層面，年輕族群、女性、自評健康較差、反對疫苗、支持極端政黨、面臨就醫障礙、感知到醫療資源不平等、對上次就醫不滿意或對醫生持負面態度者，皆更可能對醫療體系表現出低信任度。
papers.significance: 此研究填補了跨國醫療體系信任度實證研究的空白，揭示信任度不僅受個人人口學特徵與就醫經驗影響，更與國家層面的結構性貪腐及資源分配不公密切相關。這為各國政策制定者提供了明確的介入切入點，強調透過改善醫病關係、消除就醫障礙及打擊體系性貪腐，能有效提升民眾對醫療系統的信任，進而促進預防醫學參與與整體公共健康結果。

papers.title: Perceptions, challenges, and improvement strategies for reducing intravenous infusion use in hospitalised patients within Chinese medical institutions: a qualitative interview study.
papers.abstract: Intravenous infusions are widely used in inpatient care, yet their overuse may increase safety risks, waste healthcare resources, and impose unnecessary burdens on patients. In China, where infusion use remains high, understanding the factors influencing efforts to reduce unnecessary intravenous infusion use is of clear clinical relevance. This study explored stakeholder perceptions, perceived barriers, and potential strategies for reducing unnecessary intravenous infusion use within the broader framework of standardised and rational infusion use. A qualitative study using semi-structured interviews was conducted with healthcare professionals and hospitalised patients. Purposive sampling ensured variation in participant roles, hospital levels, and demographic characteristics. Data were analysed using a hybrid qualitative approach, with inductive thematic analysis as the overarching framework and selected grounded theory coding procedures used to support code development, category construction, and theme refinement, rather than to generate a formal grounded theory. Stakeholders showed varying levels of awareness regarding national expectations for standardised and rational intravenous infusion use. References by participants to "reducing infusion use" were interpreted cautiously as indicating uneven understanding or dissemination of the broader rational-use policy framework, including the reduction of unnecessary infusion, rather than lack of awareness of a reduction-specific national target. Physicians' prescribing decisions were influenced by clinical considerations, patient expectations, and medical insurance audit pressures. Nurses generally viewed reducing unnecessary infusion use as beneficial for improving workflow and reducing workload. Pharmacists highlighted both their important role in promoting rational drug use and the challenges they faced, including staffing shortages, limited training opportunities, and role ambiguity in clinical collaboration. Patients expressed mixed attitudes toward intravenous infusions, with some favouring them because of their perceived rapid effects and limited awareness of potential risks. Across stakeholder groups, reducing unnecessary infusion use emerged as a negotiation between clinical need, patient expectations, policy and insurance audit pressures, and the uneven authority and capacity of different professional groups. Strategy-related findings, derived mainly from healthcare professional accounts and contextualised by patient accounts of expectations, risk awareness, and acceptability, concerned strengthened education and training, better policy alignment, pharmacist capacity building, clinical pathway development, and interdepartmental collaboration. This study identified key barriers to reducing unnecessary intravenous infusion use within the broader framework of standardised and rational infusion use in Chinese medical institutions and highlighted stakeholder-informed strategies for improvement. The findings may inform quality-improvement efforts to promote more rational intravenous infusion use. Further research is needed to evaluate the effectiveness of specific interventions in practice.
papers.summary: 本研究透過半結構式訪談，探討中國醫療機構中減少住院患者不必要靜脈輸液使用的看法、障礙與策略。結果顯示，各方對相關政策的認知參差不齊，醫師的處方決策受臨床考量、患者期望及醫保審計壓力影響；護理人員認為減少輸液有助於減輕工作負荷；藥師則面臨人員短缺與角色模糊等挑戰；而患者多因追求速效而偏好輸液。減少不必要輸液實為臨床需求、患者期望、政策壓力與專業權限間的協商過程。
papers.significance: 此研究釐清了中國醫療體系中推動靜脈輸液合理使用的核心障礙，並提出涵蓋加強教育訓練、完善政策配套、提升藥師能力及促進跨部門合作的改善策略。這些發現不僅有助於醫療機構制定精準的品質提升方案，促進資源合理配置與患者安全，也為未來評估特定干預措施成效提供了重要的實證基礎。

papers.title: Dissociable individuals' neural responses to morality and competence evaluations during the anticipatory and consummatory stages.
papers.abstract: Previous studies have shown that individuals assign differential weight to morality versus competence during feedback processing. However, these studies failed to disentangle the anticipatory and consummatory stages from feedback processing. Therefore, using event-related potentials, the current study adapted an effort-based prosocial task to explore individuals' neural response to morality and competence evaluations in both the anticipatory and consummatory stages. Behaviorally, an interaction effect between evaluation valence and evaluation dimension showed that competence evaluations were rated as more negative than morality evaluations when evaluations were negative, while competence evaluations were rated as more arousing than morality evaluations when evaluations were positive. The ERP results revealed that, during the anticipatory stage, the Cue-P3 was larger when participants received competence cues relative to morality cues in positive contexts. Conversely, the SPN was larger after receiving morality cues compared to competence cues in positive contexts. In the consummatory stages, the LPP was larger for morality evaluations compared to competence evaluations, regardless of positive or negative evaluations. In conclusion, these results provide evidence for a dissociable effect between morality and competence evaluations during both anticipatory and consummatory stages.
papers.summary: 本研究透過事件相關電位技術探討個體在預期與消費階段對道德與能力評估的神經反應差異。行為結果顯示，負面能力評估比負面道德評估更被視為負面，而正面能力評估則比正面道德評估更具喚醒度。腦電波結果指出，在預期階段的正面情境下，能力線索引發較大的Cue-P3，而道德線索引發較大的SPN；在消費階段，無論評估正負，道德評估皆引發較大的LPP波幅。此結果證實了道德與能力評估在兩個階段中具有可分離的神經機制。
papers.significance: 此研究突破過去無法區分反饋處理中預期與消費階段的限制，首次提供明確的神經生理學證據，證明大腦在處理道德與能力資訊時存在獨立且可分離的時間動態過程。這不僅深化了對社會認知二維度（道德與能力）評價機制的理解，也為未來探討社會判斷與決策的認知神經基礎提供了重要的理論依據與方法學參考。

papers.title: Individual differences in lexical decision speed for Chinese single-character words are predicted by ND250 peak latency.
papers.abstract: Reading is a fundamental cognitive skill in modern society that relies on the rapid recognition of visual word forms. Event-related potentials (ERPs) provide a powerful tool for investigating the neural dynamics underlying visual word recognition. Establishing neural-behavior relationships is crucial for characterizing the neural mechanisms underlying specific aspects of behavior. The present study examined whether individual differences in lexical decision speed are associated with the temporal dynamics of the ND250-an ERP component reflecting neural differentiation between real words and pseudowords (or between high- and low-frequency words). Eighty-eight native Chinese readers performed a lexical decision task on real and pseudo Chinese characters while electroencephalographic (EEG) activity was recorded. All real characters used as stimuli were monomorphemic single-character words. Consistent with previous research, pseudo-characters elicited a robust ND250 over occipito-temporal scalp regions, with source estimates localized to the fusiform gyrus. Critically, ND250 peak latency showed a strong positive correlation with reaction times across participants: individuals with earlier ND250 peaks responded faster in the lexical decision task. Hierarchical regression analyses further demonstrated that ND250 latency uniquely predicted lexical decision speed even when earlier (N170) and later (PD300) ERP components were included as predictors. This relationship was consistently observed for both simple and complex characters. Together, these findings suggest that the ND250 serves as an important neurophysiological marker of orthographic processing and represents a key neural mechanism underlying individual differences in the speed of recognizing written words.
papers.summary: 本研究探討中文單字詞彙判斷速度的個體差異是否與ND250（一種反映真假字神經分化的ERP成分）的時間動態相關。透過對88名中文母語者進行腦電圖（EEG）記錄與詞彙判斷任務，研究發現偽字在枕顳區誘發了穩健的ND250，且其峰值潛伏期與受試者的反應時間呈顯著正相關。層級迴歸分析進一步證實，即使在控制了早期（N170）與晚期（PD300）ERP成分後，ND250潛伏期仍能獨特預測詞彙判斷速度，此結果在簡單字與複雜字中皆一致。
papers.significance: 該研究確立了ND250作為正字法處理的重要神經生理標記，並揭示了其為書面文字識別速度個體差異的關鍵神經機制。這不僅深化了對視覺詞彙識別神經動態的理解，也為未來探討閱讀認知個體差異或相關神經機制提供了精確的腦電指標與理論依據。

papers.title: Altered neurophysiological processing of social rewards in borderline personality disorder: Insights from a social media paradigm.
papers.abstract: Individuals with Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD) have difficulty forming and maintaining relationships and may turn to social media to compensate for their lack of natural social rewards. However, despite evidence of increased social media use in this population, research has yet to explore how individuals with BPD respond to social media-based rewards at the neurophysiological level. To address this, we recorded EEG from 21 BPD patients and 23 age- and gender-matched healthy controls (HC) as they engaged in a novel paradigm in which they received performance-dependent Likes and positive and negative comments on their own Instagram photos. At a behavioral level, BPD patients rated both Likes and positive comments on their photos as less pleasant than healthy controls. At a neural level, Reward Positivity (RewP) amplitudes elicited by the receipt vs. omission of positive feedback did not differ between groups. However, they were robustly correlated with borderline traits within the BPD group, such that patients with more pronounced traits showed a blunted RewP response to positive feedback, which could contribute to their difficulty in deriving pleasure from social rewards. Notably, the association between borderline traits and RewP in the BPD group was weakened when controlling for co-occurring psychopathology, suggesting that broader affective distress may contribute to this relationship. While future studies are warranted to isolate BPD-specific alterations, current findings provide novel insights into the neural mechanisms that may underlie social dysfunction in BPD.
papers.summary: 該研究探討邊緣型人格障礙（BPD）患者對社交媒體獎勵的神經生理反應。研究記錄了21名BPD患者與23名健康對照者在接收Instagram按讚與評論時的腦電圖。結果顯示，在行為層面上，BPD患者對按讚和正面評論的愉悅感評分顯著低於對照組；在神經層面上，雖然兩組在獲得與未獲得正面反饋時的獎勵正波（RewP）整體無顯著差異，但在BPD組內，較嚴重的邊緣特質與對正面反饋遲鈍的RewP反應顯著相關，這可能解釋他們難以從社交獎勵中獲得快感的原因。
papers.significance: 此研究首次透過社交媒體范式揭示了BPD患者處理社交獎勵的潛在神經機制。研究發現邊緣特質的嚴重程度與獎勵處理的神經反應（RewP）遲鈍有關，為理解BPD患者的人際交往障礙與社交媒體使用行為提供了新的生物學視角。此外，控制共病心理困擾後該關聯會減弱，提示未來研究需進一步釐清BPD特異性與廣泛情感困擾在獎勵處理異常中的獨立與交互作用。

papers.title: Neural correlates of metamemory judgments in worry: An ERP study.
papers.abstract: It is known that worry is associated with reduced efficiency in metamemory and metacognitive processes, yet the neural underpinnings of this relationship remain unclear. This study compared event-related potentials (ERP) during judgment of learning (JOL) and feeling of knowing (FOK) judgments in participants with high and low levels of worry. Participants' (N = 51) metamemory judgments were measured within an episodic memory task context. Although recognition memory and relative accuracy were similar between groups, significant differences were observed in metacognitive efficiency and bias. The high-worry (HW) group exhibited significantly lower confidence relative to their actual performance and reduced metacognitive efficiency compared to the low-worry (LW) group. Furthermore, HW group exhibited significantly larger P200 amplitudes compared to the LW group, whereas the LW group showed larger N200 amplitudes during both JOL and FOK judgments. The findings support the view that increased levels of worry are associated with heightened inefficiencies in mental processing and cognitive monitoring.
papers.summary: 本研究透過事件相關電位（ERP）探討高擔憂與低擔憂受試者在進行學習判斷（JOL）與知曉感判斷（FOK）時的神經差異。雖然兩組的再認記憶與相對準確度相似，但高擔憂組的元認知效率較低，且對自身表現的信心顯著不足。在腦電波特徵上，高擔憂組在元記憶判斷時展現出較大的P200波幅，而低擔憂組則呈現較大的N200波幅。
papers.significance: 此研究首次從神經生理學角度揭示了「擔憂」如何導致元認知監控效率下降，證實高擔憂狀態會伴隨認知處理過程的資源消耗與低效化。這不僅深化了對焦慮與元記憶缺陷關聯的理論理解，未來也可能為臨床上改善焦慮症患者認知偏差提供客觀的神經生物學指標。

papers.title: The impact of a loss of control over threat on stress reactivity.
papers.abstract: Uncontrollable negative events often elicit higher acute anxiety and stress than negative situations within our control. Beyond these immediate effects, some studies showed that experiences of control over negative situations may promote future resilience against stress-related impairments. Conversely, it has been shown that loss of control over threat may be more detrimental than a consistent lack of control. Whether loss of control affects stress reactivity remains poorly understood. The current study investigated the impact of loss of control over a threat on stress reactivity in humans. Eighty participants were equally assigned to either a Continuous Control or a Loss of Control group to perform a threat (un)controllability task in which they either lost or maintained control over aversive electrical stimuli. Subsequently, participants were exposed to an acute stress induction procedure (Socially Evaluated Cold Pressor Test). The experiment included assessments of perceived stress and control, salivary alpha-amylase and cortisol, blood pressure, and electrodermal activity. Additionally, participants completed questionnaires about emotion regulation strategies, general sense of control, and distress tolerance. Our results did not support the prediction that experiencing loss of control over threat heightens biological and perceived stress markers acutely or that it enhances biological reactivity to a subsequent stressor. However, we found that loss of control increased perceived stress in the subsequent task, specifically among females, which may partly reflect sex-specific stimulus duration differences inherent to the used yoking procedure. Further research is necessary to corroborate our findings and to explore the observed sex-specific vulnerability to loss of control.
papers.summary: 本研究探討失去對威脅的控制權如何影響人類的壓力反應。80名參與者被分為「持續控制組」與「失去控制組」，進行威脅不可控任務後，再接受急性壓力誘發測試。研究透過生物指標（如唾液澱粉酶、皮質醇、血壓等）與心理問卷進行評估。結果顯示，失去控制並未如預期般急性提升生物或感知壓力指標，也未增強對後續壓力源的生理反應。然而，失去控制會在後續任務中特異性地增加女性的感知壓力，這可能部分反映了實驗程序中固有的性別差異。
papers.significance: 此研究挑戰了「失去控制會加劇後續壓力生物反應」的傳統假設，證實失去控制對整體生理壓力反應的影響可能不如預期顯著。同時，研究揭示了失去威脅控制權可能對女性造成特定的心理壓力脆弱性。這對於理解壓力反應的性別差異、優化情緒調節策略，以及未來在行為科學與壓力管理領域中探討控制感喪失的影響具有重要的理論與實證參考價值。
